classifications.rationale: The President makes a policy finding about anticipated benefits; it supports discretionary executive management but does not itself change legal rights or duties.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that an on-the-job safety belt use policy for Federal employees will reduce human pain and suffering

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines a presently binding duty imposed directly on federal employees (Code 3) with mandates for agencies to promulgate implementing rules and measures later (Code 2).
classifications.evidence: Each Federal employee occupying the front seat of a motor vehicle on official business, whose seat is equipped with a safety belt, shall have the safety belt properly fastened

classifications.rationale: The Secretary of Labor must coordinate, encourage voluntary adoption by other branches, and report annually; these are administrative and reporting functions without a dictated legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of Labor shall also submit an annual report to the President

classifications.rationale: The segment assigns coordination and implementation responsibilities while preserving existing statutory powers, rights, procedures, causes of action, and liability; it does not itself alter substantive legal consequences.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of Defense shall be responsible for implementation of all provisions of this Order
